entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse is not working.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. It's broken. It just won't sync with my phone anymore.
I see. It sounds like the device might be defective. I can certainly look into your return options. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure. The name is Sam Jones, order 7-4-5-8-2-1.
Thank you, Sam. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 37 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I've checked our knowledge base. It looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, so I can definitely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh. Okay. I wasn't expecting it to be that simple.
Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Whatever. I guess that works. It's about time something with this product went smoothly.
I understand. Once we receive the defective item, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
